documentation: Step-by-step user journeys (branches, variations) are maintained in docs/USER_FLOW_MAP.md. This file defines flow IDs and metadata for Playwright @flow: tags and e2e/reporters/flow-coverage-reporter.mjs. Coverage status is NOT stored here: the single source of truth is the runtime artifact e2e-results/flow-coverage.json emitted by the reporter (CI job e2e-merge-reports). Flows registered before their spec exists must carry expectedSpecs: 0 so scripts/check-flow-definitions-sync.mjs keeps passing; remove that field in the PR that ships the spec.

trainer-tasks.name: Trainer Task Hub
trainer-tasks.description: Review pending credit reviews (meal photos + workout captures) and store redemptions; approve or reject each with a note.

trainer-settings.name: Trainer Settings Panel
trainer-settings.description: Configure the credit economy at /trainer/configuracion: pick the difficulty preset (reseeding the per-action values behind a confirmation), set the activity thresholds, and set the reschedule window that blocks late cancels and triggers the penalty.

trainer-engagement.name: Trainer Engagement Analytics
trainer-engagement.description: Fase 2 engagement over the trainer's client portfolio at /trainer/metrics: summary tiles (active streaks, check-in-today %, credits earned/spent 30d, attendance 30d) plus a per-client roster (streak, last check-in, attendance, rating). Replaces the ComingSoon placeholder.

auth-login.name: Login
auth-login.description: Authenticate with valid credentials and handle login errors.

auth-logout.name: Logout
auth-logout.description: Sign out from the app and return to a public page.

auth-session-persistence.name: Session Persistence
auth-session-persistence.description: Persist authenticated sessions across reloads and handle cookie errors.

auth-token-refresh.name: Token Refresh on Expiry
auth-token-refresh.description: When an API call returns 401 due to an expired access token, transparently refresh via /auth/token/refresh/ and retry the original request; if refresh fails, drop auth cookies and route to /login.

auth-register.name: Register
auth-register.description: Register a new account and handle registration errors.

booking-session-page.name: Book Session Page
booking-session-page.description: Access the book session page with proper auth redirects.

booking-session-flow.name: Book Session Flow
booking-session-flow.description: Select a date and slot to proceed through the booking flow.

booking-complete-flow.name: Complete Booking Flow
booking-complete-flow.description: Complete booking creation end-to-end with confirmation.

booking-error-paths.name: Booking Error Paths
booking-error-paths.description: Display booking-related API failures and error states.

booking-reschedule.name: Booking Reschedule
booking-reschedule.description: Reschedule existing bookings while enforcing time limits.

booking-calendar-redirect.name: Calendar Redirect
booking-calendar-redirect.description: Redirect the calendar route based on authentication state.

booking-calendar-edge-cases.name: Calendar Edge Cases
booking-calendar-edge-cases.description: Handle disabled days and empty availability in the calendar.

booking-no-sessions.name: No Sessions Modal
booking-no-sessions.description: Show the no sessions modal when subscriptions are exhausted.

booking-session-detail.name: Session Detail
booking-session-detail.description: View and manage session detail modal states.

app-coverage-gaps.name: App Coverage Gaps
app-coverage-gaps.description: Exercise UI states that are underserved by existing coverage.

app-edge-case-branches.name: App Edge Case Branches
app-edge-case-branches.description: Cover edge case UI branches in booking and auth flows.

app-store-error-paths.name: Store Error Paths
app-store-error-paths.description: Handle store hydration and API error branches.

app-sidebar-navigation.name: Sidebar Navigation
app-sidebar-navigation.description: Navigate the app via sidebar and mobile menu.

dashboard-overview.name: Dashboard Overview
dashboard-overview.description: Render dashboard overview sections and data.

customer-credits.name: Cliente — Mis créditos
customer-credits.description: El cliente ve su balance de créditos (dividido en disponibles y por aprobar), racha con progreso al siguiente bono, historial de transacciones y sus canjes.

customer-store.name: Cliente — Tienda
customer-store.description: El cliente ve el catálogo, su saldo disponible, canjea un artículo y ve el estado de sus canjes con el comprobante de entrega cuando aplica.

customer-buy-nutrition.name: Cliente — Comprar nutrición
customer-buy-nutrition.description: La nutrición es de pago: si el plan no la incluye, el cliente ve un candado y puede agregarla pagando el prorrateo del mes; desde la renovación se cobra junto al plan.

customer-session-grants.name: Cliente — Sesiones adicionales
customer-session-grants.description: Tras canjear una sesión adicional, el cliente ve sus sesiones extra (cantidad y vencimiento a 1 mes) y puede reservarlas desde la agenda como una fuente aparte del plan.

customer-buy-credits.name: Cliente — Comprar créditos
customer-buy-credits.description: El cliente compra créditos con dinero real vía Wompi eligiendo un paquete; al aprobarse el pago los créditos se acreditan como confirmados en su saldo.

trainer-store-management.name: Trainer — Gestión de tienda
trainer-store-management.description: El entrenador gestiona el catálogo (crear/editar con imagen, activar/desactivar) y resuelve canjes: entrega productos/servicios subiendo una foto de verificación obligatoria, o rechaza (con devolución de créditos).

my-programs-list.name: My Programs List
my-programs-list.description: Mi Suscripción at /subscription: list subscriptions, empty state, sidebar link; flow ID my-programs-list is historical.

my-programs-detail.name: My Programs Detail
my-programs-detail.description: In-page subscription detail on /subscription: cards, session tabs, session rows, session modal.

subscription-page.name: Subscription Page
subscription-page.description: View subscription details, status, and history.

checkout-flow.name: Checkout Flow
checkout-flow.description: Complete checkout page flow for subscriptions.

checkout-guest-redirect.name: Checkout Guest Redirect
checkout-guest-redirect.description: Redirect guest checkout when registration is required.

checkout-coverage-gaps.name: Checkout Coverage Gaps
checkout-coverage-gaps.description: Cover checkout edge cases and error handling.

public-home.name: Public Home
public-home.description: Render the public home page sections and CTAs.

public-navbar.name: Public Navbar
public-navbar.description: Interact with public navigation across breakpoints.

public-brand.name: Public Brand
public-brand.description: Render the Kore brand experience page.

public-programs.name: Public Programs
public-programs.description: Browse programs and handle authentication redirects.

public-contact.name: Public Contact
public-contact.description: Submit the contact form and validate required fields.

public-faq.name: Public FAQ
public-faq.description: Render FAQ content and accordion behavior.

public-faq-errors.name: Public FAQ Errors
public-faq-errors.description: Handle FAQ loading, empty, and error states.

public-terms.name: Terms & Conditions
public-terms.description: View the terms and conditions page and navigate back to programs.

public-whatsapp-cta.name: Public WhatsApp Floating CTA
public-whatsapp-cta.description: Floating WhatsApp link on selected public routes (ConditionalWhatsApp).

booking-cancel-flow.name: Booking Cancel Flow
booking-cancel-flow.description: Full cancel journey: open session detail → enter reason → confirm → verify status change.

checkout-payment-status-polling.name: Checkout Payment Status Polling
checkout-payment-status-polling.description: End-to-end polling cycle: submit → processing indicator → approved/failed resolution.

subscription-cancel-flow.name: Subscription Cancel Flow
subscription-cancel-flow.description: Subscription page cancel affordances: enabled cancel opens confirmation; expired and canceled subscriptions hide cancel.

auth-protected-routes.name: Auth Protected Routes
auth-protected-routes.description: Systematic test of authenticated routes redirecting to /login when unauthenticated.

auth-forgot-password.name: Forgot Password
auth-forgot-password.description: 3-step password reset: request code by email, verify 6-digit code, set new password.

profile-management.name: Profile Management
profile-management.description: View and edit personal information, upload avatar, select primary goal, and view mood check-in.

profile-password-change.name: Profile Password Change
profile-password-change.description: Request verification code and change password from the profile security section.

customer-diagnosis.name: Customer Diagnosis
customer-diagnosis.description: View anthropometry/body composition diagnosis with educational indicators and progress timeline.

customer-nutrition.name: Customer Nutrition Assessment
customer-nutrition.description: Complete and view nutrition assessment form with habit tracking and scoring.

customer-parq.name: Customer PAR-Q
customer-parq.description: Complete and view PAR-Q physical activity readiness questionnaire.

customer-physical-evaluation.name: Customer Physical Evaluation
customer-physical-evaluation.description: View physical evaluation results with fitness indicators and progress tracking.

customer-posturometry.name: Customer Posturometry
customer-posturometry.description: View posturometry evaluation results with regional indicators, recommendations, and a before/after photo compare lightbox with tap-to-zoom.

customer-pending-assessments.name: Pending Assessments
customer-pending-assessments.description: View KORE score and pending assessment modules on the dashboard.

trainer-dashboard.name: Trainer Dashboard
trainer-dashboard.description: View trainer stats (total clients, today sessions) and upcoming session list.

trainer-clients-list.name: Trainer Client List
trainer-clients-list.description: Search and browse assigned client list with stats and quick action links.

trainer-client-detail.name: Trainer Client Detail
trainer-client-detail.description: View individual client profile, session history, and access assessment module links.

trainer-client-anthropometry.name: Trainer Client Anthropometry
trainer-client-anthropometry.description: Create and view client anthropometry evaluations with body composition data.

trainer-client-nutrition.name: Trainer Client Nutrition
trainer-client-nutrition.description: View client nutrition assessment results and history.

trainer-client-parq.name: Trainer Client PAR-Q
trainer-client-parq.description: View client PAR-Q assessment results and risk indicators.

trainer-client-physical-eval.name: Trainer Client Physical Eval
trainer-client-physical-eval.description: Create and view client physical evaluation results with fitness indicators.

trainer-client-physical-tests.name: Trainer Biweekly Physical Test
trainer-client-physical-tests.description: Register the biweekly physical test result (passed/failed) from the Ev. Física tab; a passed test awards credits to the client.

trainer-client-posturometry.name: Trainer Client Posturometry
trainer-client-posturometry.description: Create and view client posturometry evaluations with regional analysis.

subscription-billing-failed-recovery.name: Subscription Billing Failed Recovery
subscription-billing-failed-recovery.description: Recover from a failed recurring billing attempt by updating payment method via the dashboard toast.

mobile-bottom-nav.name: Mobile Bottom Navigation (Customer)
mobile-bottom-nav.description: Navigate the customer mobile bottom bar (Inicio, Agendar, Más sheet, Logout) on small viewports.

trainer-mobile-bottom-nav.name: Mobile Bottom Navigation (Trainer)
trainer-mobile-bottom-nav.description: Navigate the trainer mobile bottom bar (Inicio, Clientes, Más sheet) on small viewports.

profile-mood-entry.name: Profile Mood Entry
profile-mood-entry.description: Record daily mood (1-10) entry from the MoodCheckIn modal that opens on the profile page.

profile-completion-cta.name: Profile Completion CTA
profile-completion-cta.description: Onboarding modal that prompts new customers with incomplete profiles to navigate to /profile and complete their information.

subscription-gated-routes.name: Subscription Gated Routes
subscription-gated-routes.description: Access control enforced by (app)/layout.tsx: customers without an active subscription are redirected to /subscription when accessing gated routes; /subscription and /profile remain accessible.

customer-mi-programa.name: Mi Programa — Overview
customer-mi-programa.description: View the customer's monthly training program overview: calendar heatmap, fitness level card, weekly adherence strip, and navigation to sub-routes (rutina, progreso, resumen).

customer-mi-programa-rutina.name: Mi Programa — Rutina del Día
customer-mi-programa-rutina.description: View today's routine: exercise list, complete/skip individual exercises, log mood/notes, and see day-level adherence.

program-workout-captures.name: Workout Camera Validation
program-workout-captures.description: Consent gate and random camera captures during the routine that validate workout-day credits.

customer-mi-programa-progreso.name: Mi Programa — Progreso
customer-mi-programa-progreso.description: View program-wide adherence charts, streak, and training/nutrition breakdown over the program duration.

customer-mi-programa-resumen.name: Mi Programa — Resumen
customer-mi-programa-resumen.description: View program summary card with goal, fitness level, dates, completion %, and projected outcome.

customer-mi-programa-dia.name: Mi Programa — Día Específico
customer-mi-programa-dia.description: Navigate to a past or future program day via /mi-programa/dia/detail?date=YYYY-MM-DD: view exercises, completion state, and trainer notes.

trainer-alerts.name: Trainer Alerts Center
trainer-alerts.description: View and filter behavioral/clinical risk alerts per client (alto/medio/bajo); resolve an alert and mark it as addressed.

trainer-client-program.name: Trainer Client Program Tab
trainer-client-program.description: View and manage a client's monthly training program from the trainer perspective: generate, publish, and review program days and exercise logs.

trainer-client-notes.name: Trainer Client Notes Tab
trainer-client-notes.description: From the client detail Notes tab, leave weekly trainer notes per 28-day cycle in the Programa and Nutrición subtabs: week 1 is editable, completing it unlocks week 2, and so on; saved weeks stack as history.

trainer-metrics.name: Trainer Metrics
trainer-metrics.description: View trainer-wide comparative metrics: adherence trends, evaluation expiry summary, risk distribution, and global KORE score across all clients.

trainer-nutrition-catalog.name: Trainer Nutrition Catalog
trainer-nutrition-catalog.description: Browse and search the global meal suggestion catalog; add new meal suggestions with block, calories, NOVA, fitness level, and goal tags.

auth-accept-invite.name: Accept Duo Invite
auth-accept-invite.description: Accept a duo-plan subscription invite via /accept-invite?token=: resolve token → accept (logged-in), redirect to login (wrong account), or redirect to register (new user).

auth-forced-password-change.name: Forced Password Change
auth-forced-password-change.description: When must_change_password=true, redirect to /change-password-required and enforce password update before accessing any other route.

admin-dashboard.name: Admin Platform Dashboard
admin-dashboard.description: View the admin overview dashboard at /admin-platform/dashboard: aggregate subscription stat tiles (total, active, expired, canceled).

admin-users-list.name: Admin Users List
admin-users-list.description: Browse the platform user list at /admin-platform/users: search by name/email, filter by role, paginate, and open the Inscribir usuario CTA.

admin-user-create.name: Admin Create User
admin-user-create.description: Enroll a new user from /admin-platform/users/new: fill email, first/last name, phone, select role (customer/trainer), and submit.

admin-user-detail.name: Admin User Detail
admin-user-detail.description: Manage a single user at /admin-platform/users/detail: edit role, toggle active/inactive, reset password, assign a trainer, and manage assigned clients.

admin-subscriptions-list.name: Admin Subscriptions List
admin-subscriptions-list.description: Browse all subscriptions at /admin-platform/subscriptions: search, filter by status, switch category tabs, and paginate.

admin-subscription-create.name: Admin Create Subscription
admin-subscription-create.description: Create or evolve a subscription via the /admin-platform/subscriptions/new wizard: pick customer, package, and payment method, add notes, and confirm.

admin-subscription-detail.name: Admin Subscription Detail
admin-subscription-detail.description: Manage a subscription at /admin-platform/subscriptions/detail: change status, renew (expired/canceled only), or delete via confirmation modals.

admin-plans.name: Admin Plans CRUD
admin-plans.description: Manage the package/plan catalog at /admin-platform/plans: create and edit packages via a modal with category, price, sessions, and validity fields.

admin-nutrition.name: Admin Nutrition Add-on
admin-nutrition.description: Manage the nutrition add-on at /admin-platform/nutricion: edit the monthly COP price (confirming the impact on active subscriptions), toggle the add-on active, and flip includes_nutrition per plan.

admin-reports.name: Admin Reports / KPIs
admin-reports.description: Business KPI panel at /admin-platform/reports: revenue (subscriptions + Wompi credit top-ups) with a fixed 6-month trend, subscription status counts, credit economy (earned/spent/redemptions) and rating quality, filtered by a preset window (today/30d/90d/all).

customer-session-rating.name: Post-Session Rating
customer-session-rating.description: After a trainer confirms attendance, the customer rates the session from a dashboard card (1-5 stars + optional comment), earning session_rated credits. Skipping leaves it unrated.

customer-nutrition-daily.name: Daily Nutrition Tracking
customer-nutrition-daily.description: Track daily nutrition on /my-nutrition: mark individual meals as done, upload a meal photo via the camera, log water glasses, and view the daily history.

customer-nutrition-plan.name: Customer Nutrition Plan
customer-nutrition-plan.description: View the trainer-authored weekly nutrition plan on /my-nutrition — the coach-note strip on the daily hero, sourced from /api/my-nutrition-plans/.

subscription-duo-invite.name: Subscription DUO Guest Invite
subscription-duo-invite.description: From the subscription page, the plan owner invites a DUO guest by email, revokes a guest, and accepts a pending invitation.

trainer-client-nutrition-plan.name: Trainer Client Nutrition Plan
trainer-client-nutrition-plan.description: From the client detail Nutrición tab, generate, edit meals, and publish a weekly nutrition plan (distinct from the read-only nutrition-habits viewer).

trainer-client-booking.name: Trainer Books For Client
trainer-client-booking.description: Book or reschedule a session on behalf of an assigned client via the TrainerBookingDialog on the client list and client detail.

trainer-client-messaging.name: Trainer Post-Session Message
trainer-client-messaging.description: Send a message to a client from the client detail (Notas → Sesiones message composer), POST /api/trainer/messages/. Note: the PostSessionMessageSheet component has no wired trigger on the current client-detail page; the reachable surface is the MessageComposerCard.

customer-trainer-message.name: Customer Trainer Message
customer-trainer-message.description: Customer receives and dismisses trainer messages via the TrainerMessageModal overlay in the app shell (my-trainer-messages).
